packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time Operations Participants/Members route renders wrapped/contained tabs, readable participant table text, and a proportionate command-bot empty panel on desktop and mobile without changing CRM data, filters, actions, APIs, or bot behavior.

title: Participants Members Readability Cleanup

reasons: Fresh screenshots show the One Time contacts subtab rail clipped on desktop and mobile.
The Participants/Members data table uses dark table text on a dark table surface and is hard to read.
The Command Bot Actions empty panel is large and bright, visually dominating the participant roster route.
likely_external_provider_blockers: CRM imports, campaign sends, WhatsApp/email, payments/access, external account writes, and bot mutations are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this participants cleanup, continue manual screenshot-reviewed packets for CRM contact detail polish, IA/nav/filter cleanup, or remaining portal defects.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time Participants/Members route feel even and clean by fixing clipped tabs, unreadable table text, and oversized empty command-bot presentation.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No CRM/contact import, dedupe, no-send, communication, participant row, payment/access, question, message, bot preview, typed action, API, route access, or helper behavior change.
No public landing, parent portal, student portal, provider portal, classroom, payments, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Stripe, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account, campaign, or access-grant change.
No GHL runtime, LeadConnector reference, external CRM write, external send/publish/upload/payment, raw private evidence, or secret exposure.

inspection_targets: public/css/one-time-operations.css One Time Operations route overrides
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The Contacts/Participants subtab rail clips tabs at the right edge on desktop and mobile.
The Participants/Members table header and row text are dark-on-dark and hard to read.
The Command Bot Actions empty panel is bright, oversized, and visually louder than the actual participant roster.

expanded_phrases.clean: The participants route should read like a compact Operations roster, not a mix of clipped navigation, hidden table text, and a dominant empty bot panel.
expanded_phrases.even: Top tabs, heading, participant table, and command-bot empty state should align within a consistent One Time admin surface.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: Once data loads, the route should immediately show a readable Participants/Members title, contained tabs, readable row text, and an empty command-bot state that does not overpower the page.
expanded_phrases.CRM: For this packet, CRM means the first-party BNA Operations contacts/participants roster UI only: readable tabs, rows, counts, and local command-preview surfaces without imports, external CRM runtime, sends, or mutations.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The participants route remains a first-party BNA Operations CRM/roster view scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix One Time Participants/Members readability so the contacts subtab rail is contained, the participant table text is readable, and the command-bot empty state no longer dominates the route.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile participant screenshots show wrapped/contained tabs, readable table headers and row text, and a compact dark command-bot empty state with no horizontal overflow.
acceptance_criteria: The Participants/Members route has a scoped One Time route marker for CSS targeting.
The One Time contacts top filter rail wraps or contains all tabs on desktop and mobile without clipping text.
Participant table headers, row text, and section counters are readable in the One Time dark theme.
The Command Bot Actions empty state is visually quiet and proportionate to the roster content.
CRM data, filters, rows, command bot actions, APIs, action registry, and external-provider guardrails are unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Current screenshot evidence shows the participants route clipping and readability defects.
The likely fix is scoped to route marker markup and One Time Operations CSS overrides.
No CRM data, send/publish/payment/access, external provider, credential, or account decision is required for local implementation.
